label: Derogation type
definition: The provision under which the deadline may be extended.

label: Derogation status
definition: Whether an extension is requested under the provision.

label: Extended deadline
definition: The year by the end of which the requirement will be met, under the extension.

label: Eligibility criterion
definition: The criterion on which the Member State relies for eligibility: the share of agglomerations or the share of their load.

label: Agglomerations not meeting the requirement
definition: Number of agglomerations concerned not meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

label: Agglomerations meeting the requirement
definition: Number of agglomerations concerned meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

label: Load not meeting the requirement
definition: Generated load of the agglomerations concerned not meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

label: Load meeting the requirement
definition: Generated load of the agglomerations concerned meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

label: Reason type
definition: Whether the reasons for the extension are technical, economic or both. Select one or both.

label: Reason reference
definition: Reference to the technical or economic reasons justifying the extension.

label: Investment plan reference
definition: Reference to the plan detailing the investments needed to meet the requirement within the extended deadline.
